name: CRONE
tagline: Style, beauty and a full life for women in their second half
description: CRONE is a magazine for women over fifty who intend to enjoy every year: makeup and hair for changing faces, wardrobe and style, everyday movement, home and garden, friendship and purpose, and travel — written with warmth, honesty and no anti-ageing panic.
author: The CRONE editors

categories.name: Beauty After Fifty
categories.description: Makeup that flatters a changing face, going grey with style, hair that thins, nails, fragrance and a calm daily routine.

categories.name: Style & Wardrobe
categories.description: Dressing the body you have now: fit, colour, capsule wardrobes, comfortable shoes that still look good and shopping with intention.

categories.name: Move & Thrive
categories.description: Walking, strength, balance, flexibility and restful sleep habits for everyday energy, explained simply and safely.

categories.name: Home & Garden
categories.description: Decluttering, downsizing, a home that ages with you, and gardens and balconies that are a joy rather than a chore.

categories.name: Purpose & Connection
categories.description: Friendship, family, grandparenting, volunteering, learning new skills and finding meaning after work and child-raising.

categories.name: Travel & Discovery
categories.description: Solo trips, slow travel, packing light, travelling comfortably and planning journeys that suit your pace and curiosity.
